findings.message: The before capture shows the toss velocity as +0.98 m/s, which is 9.8 × 0.1 and correct. The drop ball is still held, so the lanes differ before the release. This matches the plan.

The velocity arrow at the end runs from y=243 to y=303. That is 60 px for 5 m/s, which is consistent with the start. It extends below the lane box (bottom at y=279). I can't judge clipping without pixels.
